verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Multi-Site page title, "One Platform, Multiple Brands and Regions," which suggests region-specific storefronts from one platform. Nothing in the pack shows how localization works, and the other parts of the story are not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: documented multi-currency pricing, storefront translation or multi-language support, duties and taxes calculation at checkout, detail on how regional storefronts are localized, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
